messages.author: Ranim Maaieh
messages.body:
Hi,
Is there a way to renumber residues in trajectory files from simulations?
Thanks!

messages.author: Kenneth Huang
messages.body:
Hi,
I think you want something like this-
parmed
parm in.prmtop
addpdb ref.pdb
parmout out.prmtop
And then I believe you can load the new pdb back into cpptraj, and it
should have the residue numbering from the ref.pdb file?
Best,
Kenneth
